notes: Self-contained DSSE attestation vector. Consumed by typescript/tests/dsse-attestation.test.ts via verifyAttestation, not the universal oracle runner: the oracle runner drives verify() over a top-level manifest and its gate hardcodes the existing vector count, while verifyAttestation is a separate offline entry point with its own verdict shape. Negative fixtures (tampered digest, tampered signature, revoked key, unknown kid) are derived in that test by mutation, matching the offline-verify.test.ts style.
